function.name: request_ride
function.description: Submit a request for a ride, involving the user's current location and destination information.

pickup_location.description: The current location of the user for pick-up.

destination.description: The destination where the user wants to go.

ride_type.description: The type of ride (e.g., standard, luxury, shared).

function.name: view_ride_history
function.description: View the user's past ride history, which may reveal travel patterns and preferences.

user_id.description: The identifier of the user requesting the ride history.

start_date.description: Start date for filtering past ride history.

end_date.description: End date for filtering past ride history.

function.name: pay_ride_fare
function.description: Pay for the ride fare, involving the user's payment account and the total fare amount.

ride_id.description: Unique identifier for the ride being paid for.

payment_method.description: The payment method selected by the user (e.g., credit card, PayPal).

amount.description: The total fare amount to be paid.

function.name: share_location
function.description: Share the user's current location with the driver or other users for coordination or safety purposes.

recipient_id.description: The identifier of the recipient (e.g., the driver or a contact person).

location.description: The current geographic location of the user.

function.name: rate_driver
function.description: Allow the user to rate the driver after the ride, which may influence the driver's future ratings and interactions.

ride_id.description: The identifier for the completed ride being rated.

rating.description: The rating given to the driver, typically on a scale of 1-5.

feedback.description: Optional textual feedback regarding the driver's service.

function.name: view_coupons
function.description: View and use available coupons or discounts for the user's account, impacting the overall fare payment.

user_id.description: The identifier for the user requesting the coupons.

coupon_code.description: An optional specific coupon code to apply, if available.
